description.en: Diagram showing light from a single source S passing through two slits S1 and S2, creating an interference pattern on the screen.
description.hi: एकल स्रोत S से निकलने वाला प्रकाश दो स्लिटों S1 और S2 से गुजरकर स्क्रीन पर व्यतिकरण प्रतिरूप बनाता है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(50, 150)">
    <!-- Source S -->
    <circle cx="-20" cy="0" r="3" fill="#f59e0b" />
    <text x="-35" y="5" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">S</text>

    <!-- Double Slit plane -->
    <line x1="50" y1="100" x2="50" y2="40" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="50" y1="20" x2="50" y2="-20" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="4" />
    <line x1="50" y1="-40" x2="50" y2="-100" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="4" />
    
    <!-- Slits -->
    <text x="30" y="-35" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">S1</text>
    <text x="30" y="45" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">S2</text>

    <!-- Screen -->
    <rect x="300" y="-120" width="10" height="240" fill="#d1d5db" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" />
    
    <!-- Central axis -->
    <line x1="50" y1="0" x2="300" y2="0" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <text x="320" y="5" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">O</text>

    <!-- Point P on screen -->
    <circle cx="305" cy="-70" r="3" fill="#ef4444" />
    <text x="320" y="-65" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">P</text>

    <!-- Light rays -->
    <line x1="-20" y1="0" x2="50" y2="-30" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />
    <line x1="-20" y1="0" x2="50" y2="30" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2,2" />

    <line x1="50" y1="-30" x2="300" y2="-70" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="50" y1="30" x2="300" y2="-70" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Distances -->
    <path d="M 315 0 L 315 -70" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" marker-start="url(#arrow)" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="325" y="-30" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#3b82f6">y</text>

    <path d="M 50 110 L 300 110" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" marker-start="url(#arrow)" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="170" y="130" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#3b82f6">D</text>

    <path d="M 35 -30 L 35 30" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" marker-start="url(#arrow)" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="20" y="5" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#3b82f6">d</text>
  </g>
</svg>
